_comment: PHASE 9 recovery item 14C recorded this as a design gate: BossAILogic and EnemyAILogic were authored against an API this engine never had, and the chase chain did not fail at one missing node -- the majority of its edges dangled (Boss 16/23, Enemy 20/25). Item 14C declined to adopt the vector API; item 14D chose scalar reauthoring; item 14D.2 proved it in a prototype. PHASE 9 recovery item 14E applied it to both assets, and these numbers are the result, not the original measurement -- each chain keeps its pre-14E counts under '_before_item14E'. What remains unresolved is the animation debt alone (set_animator_parameter, animator.set_trigger, variable.increment), which item 14E deliberately did not touch. The decision fields below are unchanged: the vector API was still not adopted.
